questions.question: Who is currently top of the Premier League table today, Sunday, 22nd Nov 2026?
questions.clue: This North London club plays its home matches at the Emirates Stadium.
questions.funFact: They sit clear at the summit on 28 points after 11 matches played in the 2026–27 season.

questions.question: Arsenal drew 2-2 in the late match yesterday (Saturday); who were they playing?
questions.clue: Known as "The Magpies," they play their home fixtures at St. James' Park.
questions.funFact: Noni Madueke scored a late equalizer to rescue a point for the Gunners after the hosts mounted a spirited second-half comeback.

questions.question: Manchester City also drew their match yesterday against Fulham; what was the score?
questions.clue: A low-scoring stalemate where each team found the net exactly once.
questions.funFact: Both sides shared the spoils with a goal apiece in an evenly contested Premier League clash.

questions.question: Which former Everton and Manchester United player celebrates his birthday today (39)?
questions.clue: A towering midfield powerhouse famous for his dominant aerial ability and iconic afro hairstyle.
questions.funFact: Standing at 6ft 4in, he made over 250 Premier League appearances across his spells at Goodison Park and Old Trafford, winning the FA Cup, League Cup, and Europa League with United.

questions.question: Chelsea were soundly beaten yesterday (Saturday) by Leeds United 1-4 at Stamford Bridge; what year did that last happen?
questions.funFact: Noah Okafor scored a brace alongside goals from Dominic Calvert-Lewin and Brenden Aaronson to hand Leeds their first away win at Stamford Bridge this century.

questions.question: What nationality is Marouane Fellaini?
questions.clue: He hails from the same European footballing nation as Eden Hazard and Kevin De Bruyne.
questions.funFact: He earned 87 senior international caps and scored 18 goals for his country, helping them finish third at the 2018 FIFA World Cup.

questions.question: What shirt number did birthday boy Marouane Fellaini wear for the majority of his career at Manchester United?
questions.clue: An odd double-digit number equal to three cubed (3×3×3).
questions.funFact: After initially wearing number 31 during his debut campaign under David Moyes, he switched to this double-digit squad number for the remainder of his time at Old Trafford.

questions.question: How many Premier League titles did Marouane Fellaini win?
questions.clue: The digit representing none at all.
questions.funFact: Despite lifting major domestic and European cup silverware during his career in England, a Premier League championship medal eluded him.

questions.question: Who is Liverpool's top scorer so far this season?
questions.clue: A prolific Swedish striker whose name begins with A and I.
questions.funFact: His clinical finishing and movement in the final third have spearheaded Liverpool's attack throughout the opening months of the season.

questions.question: What is the seating capacity of the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium?
questions.clue: A number sitting right in the middle between 52,850 and 72,850.
questions.funFact: Opened in April 2019, it is the largest club stadium in London and features the world's first dividing, retractable pitch.
